description: Opt-out dengan panduan untuk NumLookup, yang mencantumkan orang berdasarkan nomor telepon. Satu opt-out mencakup setiap nomor telepon yang disimpan.
instructions: Buka https://www.numlookup.com/opt_out, enter one of these numbers, finish the robot check and choose to remove your information: {all_phones}. Choose to send a removal request by hand (you don't need an account) and fill in {full_name}, {contact_email} and the number. The form may ask for a photo ID. You can black out everything on it except your name and photo. Kemudian tekan "Saya sudah melakukan ini".
